content: अभ्युदित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Risen; occurred. .²2 Elevated, risen to prosperity. .²3 Asleep at sunrise, over whom the sun has risen; सूर्येण ह्यभिनिर्मुक्तः शयानोऽभ्युदितश्च यः <ls>Ms. 2. 221</ls>. .²4 Celebrated as a festival. .{@-ता@} <ab>N.</ab> of a religious ceremony. .{@-तम्@} Rising, sunrise.
